results.title: Bomba
results.overview: In the Balkan region, where lawlessness prevailed during the war, a man receives a threatening death letter from the gang he used to be a member of. Thereupon, he plans to escape to America with his pregnant wife. On the last night, after being threatened by the gang, the man leaves the house to persuade the gang members, but does not come back. Instead, an hour later, gang members enter the house. The gang leader starts a game in which he tells the woman that if she fulfills his wishes, she can see her husband again as a reward.

results.title: Sana: Let Me Hear
results.overview: During the summer vacation period, temporary teacher Honoka Kimijima is in charge of a supplementary class. One day, a female student suddenly jumps off from the school rooftop and dies in front of Honoka Kimijima.

results.title: The Lost Children
results.overview: After a plane crash, four indigenous children fight to survive in the Colombian Amazon using ancestral wisdom as an unprecedented rescue mission unfolds.

results.title: The Farewell
results.overview: Behind the scenes footage from 'Solitær' and 'Dan Lehwer' is combined in essayistic fashion as the director of both films bids farewell to the short film format and welcomes new opportunities.

results.title: Tummy Tom and the Lost Teddybear
results.original_title: Dikkie Dik en de verdwenen knuffel
results.overview: When his favorite cuddly toy goes missing, Tummy Tom and his best friend Cat Mouse set out on an adventure beyond the garden to find it.

results.title: Stick Up
results.overview: The story follows two high school friends who attempt to transform the lives of two women by involving them in drug dealing and prostitution. However, things take a turn for the worse when they realize the true dangers of their actions. Now, it's up to Tierney to save her friend from the path of destruction!

results.title: KIX
results.overview: Handheld skate video meets hardcore social realism in a sensational film with the energy of a three-chord punk song and an unruly group of street kids in front of the camera, shot over 10 wild years of their young lives.

results.title: The Cafone
results.overview: A manipulative New Jersey bottom-feeder brings disarray and mayhem to the lives of everyone around him.

results.title: Here and There
results.overview: A visa problem forces Adrien back to Paris after 15 years in Senegal with his wife Aminata. Her cousin Sékou, now distanced from his Senegalese origins, takes in Adrien. As Adrien awaits his return, Sékou shows him France, sparking surprises.

results.title: Reas
results.overview: Gentle or rough, blonde or shaved, cis or trans, long term inmates or those newly admitted: women re-enact their lives in a Buenos Aires prison, in trance and balance, voguing and singing. A hybrid musical and charming piece of collective empowerment.

results.title: King Kong: Monster and Myth
results.original_title: « King Kong » : le cœur des ténèbres
results.overview: In 1933, Merian C. Cooper and Ernest B. Schoedsack, two audacious and visionary directors, dared to create a motion picture that eclipsed everything seen until then: when King Kong was released, it was celebrated as an artistic and technical revolution and became the first myth created by the young cinematic art.

results.title: Sans Dieu
results.overview: Gabriel and Xavier spend their afternoons playing, wandering the countryside, and exploring abandoned places. All seems peaceful, but a feeling is tormenting Gabriel. Is it love or religion ?

results.title: DUCK (installation)
results.overview: An installation centred around Rachel Maclean's newest video work, DUCK, framed in a highly synthetic environment with walls of a particularly familiar green colour.

results.title: Bringing Someone to Life
results.overview: After their mother moves them to a new town to start over, siblings Luke and Madison, who are still reeling from the absence of their father years prior, decide to go back to the home that was taken from them to see their dad again.

results.title: La ciudad que ocupamos
results.overview: Molly (35), a trans woman, takes care of her father Manuel in the house she abandoned in her adolescence. When a woman visits him unexpectedly, they are both forced to face their fears and expectations.

results.title: Frena.
results.overview: Carmen, a woman haunted by family tragedy, drives at night after a long day of work. To fight sleep, she decides to stop in a gas station to rest. There, she meets a shadow of her past who could explain her present.

results.title: How I Met Her Mom
results.overview: You can take a young man out of the Caucasus, but never take the Caucasus out of a young man. Apparently, the Caucasian relatives of the Russified Ossetian thought so when they decided to help him, following the ancient tradition, to ride his St. Petersburg bride to the village. But what if, in the end, the wrong bride ends up in the car, the family learns David's main secret, and for all the guests who have gathered, the wedding will still need to be held? Then "Caucasian Bollywood" will come.

results.title: Buzz of the Earth
results.overview: In this mockumentary, the European Space Agency forms a team of scientists to craft a message to send to alien civilizations. As they work to compile a comprehensive report on humanity, the team is faced with unexpected challenges, including debates on what should be said and how it should be expressed.

results.title: Jimmy Carr: Natural Born Killer
results.overview: Jimmy Carr refutes the idea that you can't joke about anything these days with his edgy takes on gun control, religion, cancel culture and consent.

results.title: The Prophet
results.overview: An artist reflects on her career and the dark events of her past that haunt her
